scenario.description: An assistant principal must approve the launch plan for a student peer-mediation program, including the student mediator roster, referral scope, supervision, meeting schedule, and safety records, with input from a teacher, school counselor, and school psychologist.

agents.name: Ms. Patel
agents.role: Social Studies Teacher and Peer-Mediation Advisor

shared_context.S1: The middle school plans to launch a student peer-mediation program for the spring semester.
shared_context.S2: The current draft proposes twelve student mediators, mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, one adult supervisor, and referrals for minor and moderate student conflicts.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morgan gives final approval for the program's operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The school's standard student-services approval checklist requires the peer-mediation advisor to report the roster and training status, the counselor to report referral-screening requirements, and the school psychologist to report safety and supervision requirements before an operating plan can be approved.
shared_context.S5: At the student-services planning meeting, each specialist reports their assigned checklist item in one uninterrupted round, and Dr. Morgan records the reports and required plan changes before making the final approval decision.

PF1.text: Ms. Patel's classroom observation and training log show that M4 and M9 have not completed the required mediation practicum, while M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10, M11, and M12 have completed it; she recorded this in her advisor notes this week but has not entered it into the program roster.

PF2.text: Mr. Lewis's current student-services file review identifies active no-contact orders involving students Nia and Omar; referrals involving either student must be screened out of peer mediation, and he confirmed the orders with the families this week but has not added the screening requirement to the draft.

PF3.text: Dr. Romero's safety review finds that student mediators may handle only minor peer conflicts and may not handle threats or moderate conflicts; the approved operating protocol must assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session, and she finalized this review yesterday but has not attached it to the launch proposal.

acceptance_conditions: The mediator roster must include exactly the ten students who completed the practicum and exclude M4 and M9.
Sessions must occur on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch.
The program must accept only minor peer conflicts.
Nia and Omar must be excluded from peer-mediation referrals.
Every mediation session must have two adult supervisors.
A training-verification record must be committed.
A no-contact screening record must be committed.
A safety-supervision protocol must be committed.
The no-contact-order fact must be cited after being revealed.

content_checks.C2: decisions['meeting_days'] in ['Monday/Wednesday', 'Monday and Wednesday during lunch', 'Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch', 'Mondays and Wednesdays']
content_checks.C3: decisions['referral_scope'] == 'minor conflicts only' or decisions['referral_scope'] == 'minor peer conflicts only'
content_checks.C6: any('roster' in c['detail'] or 'practicum' in c['detail'] or 'training' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('screen' in c['detail'] or 'no-contact' in c['detail'] or 'no contact' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('safety' in c['detail'] or 'supervis' in c['detail'] or 'minor' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The training record changes the roster from all twelve proposed mediators to the exact ten completed students, excluding M4 and M9, and requires a training-related roster record.
The two active no-contact orders change the exclusion list to exactly Nia and Omar, require a screening commitment, and provide the specific fact that must be cited.
The safety review changes the referral scope to minor conflicts only, raises supervision from one to exactly two adults per session, and requires a safety-related operating-plan commitment.
